dedupe_keys.name: greater noumea atlas of public facilities atlas gie serail

description: GIE SERAIL (Greater Nouméa) publishes the point locations of the public facilities of greater Nouméa in nine families: education, sport, administration, justice and security, culture and social-educational, health and social, transport and waste, worship, and parks and leisure; fields include a short name, three theme levels, neighbourhood, delivery date, manager and coordinates. Coverage: the greater Nouméa area, New Caledonia; about 1,900 points, record last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of New Caledonia (data.gouv.nc). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence Ouverte v2.0; cost: free. Caveats: the data remain the exclusive property of GIE SERAIL and are shared under the Etalab open licence 2.0 with general conditions of use that require crediting the source and the group logo. Simulation uses: critical-facility exposure, service accessibility and shelter-siting analyses for cyclone, flood and fire scenarios. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: Greater Nouméa: Atlas of public facilities (ATLAS, GIE SERAIL)
